items: Radio stations like talkSPORT and BBC Radio 5 Live are no longer offered for matches.
Refreshing Now or Sports also updates your playlist, so Watch Live finds the latest event channels.
The server line on Now checks again when you come back to the app, instead of showing an old 'Not Answering'.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
